rows.capability: Init preserves a project's recorded plan engine (and plan.dir) when no engine flag is given
rows.runtimeOwner: packages/cli/src/init.mjs — `forge init` CLI command, run per project (and by every install/upgrade that re-inits)
rows.writes: plan.engine / plan.dir in the project's .forge/config.json (or leaves them unchanged when recorded)
rows.reads: the project's existing .forge/config.json, the engine flags, and the user default
rows.uiConsumer: every later forge phase, which routes plan commands by the recorded engine; the init report JSON

rows.capability: Init preserves a project's recorded adr.enabled when no ADR flag is given
rows.library: packages/cli/src/init.mjs — the ADR resolution block (opts.adr === null path)
rows.writes: adr.enabled / adr.dir / adr.decisionsDoc in .forge/config.json, and ADR scaffold files on disk (or none when the recorded value disables ADRs)
rows.reads: the project's existing .forge/config.json adr block, the ADR flags, and the user default
rows.uiConsumer: the archive-to-adr flow and the pending-ADR hooks, which only fire when adr.enabled
